name: Bulwark shove - a unit that did not walk, and walks back by its route
notes: Milestone 16's test effect for a Grid that changes under a unit. A Citizen bulwark stands still; every two seconds it shoves each enemy touching it two tiles straight away (its Shove ability, through the kernel's rule for a unit that did not walk). Two Ravel runners come at it, one from the west and one from straight above, where a rock two rows north stops the shove after one tile. A pushed runner lands where its body fits, says so (entity.displaced), and on the next tick walks back to the bulwark by its route from where it landed.
